title: Where should the ownership map live, and what information may it contain?
question: Where should the ownership map live, and what information may it contain?
answer:
FND-Q22A: Yes. The ownership map owns the maintained record of artifact classes, responsibilities, scopes, routes and relations, and answers where a truth belongs, including the Blueprint -> Spec -> Task relationships the other controls do not answer. It routes to the artifacts holding claims and never copies them or tracks live card instances. The Taskboard is a derived projection that summarizes Spec and Task records.
FND-Q23A: A separate map is needed: OWNERSHIP.json at the repository root as the eighth root file, a Core routing artifact outside the three-file Contract; root placement never implies Contract membership. The ownership schema leaves LEXICON.md, which keeps shared language and routes ownership questions to the map. ADR-0013 must be superseded. On 2026-09-22 the "root control" label was dropped: it is the Ownership map, a routing artifact.

confirmation.basis: Each source answer was owner-settled in its grilling session, per the grilling ledger at 56b459da: FND-Q22A, FND-Q23A (locked). The card's grouping, title and synthesis are agent work (2026-09-26 draft grouping and the 2026-10-01 ledger backfill), not separately owner-confirmed.
